handoff: Raid: 3 raiders dart from the nest side to the hit lane (35 percent from the source world), at 40 percent of the beat a flash disc and red ring open, a camera nudge and a low tone play, pods tumble out and the raiders leave; ships cleared at 2.2 s. Scoop: 4 pods fly from a ring round the Flagship into it (1.2 s) with a short tone. Reclaim: when the flip starts the camera eases to the world (2 s, game time, yields to player steering) with the chime tone. Opening: other worlds in view send ships to the capital, a 12-segment ring lights segment by segment over 70 percent of 3.2 s, then a 0.5 s screen flash; a banner fades in; the camera eases to the capital; end screen after 3.4 s. All overlay nodes ignore the mouse. Everything scales with Juice.motion (0 = off). Saved fields: none, so no save bump.
